name: Unone glTF
description: Import glTF 2.0 binary models (.glb) as static meshes with their base colour texture and a matching material, through the engine's import pipeline.

tools.name: plugin.test
tools.title: Test the importer wiring
tools.description: Parse a generated GLB the way inspect does and check the bundled Luau importer is present.

tools.name: gltf.inspect
tools.title: Inspect a GLB
tools.description: Meshes, triangles, materials, textures, required extensions and what the importer will and will not read.

tools.name: gltf.plan
tools.title: Plan an import
tools.description: Show the importer module, import root, asset declarations and scene material that gltf.apply would add, without writing anything.

name.description: Base name for mesh://<name>, texture://<name> and the material; defaults to the file name.

tools.name: gltf.apply
tools.title: Import a GLB
tools.description: Copy the importer to import/unone-gltf.luau, register it and an import root, declare mesh://<name> and texture://<name> assets imported from the GLB, and add a material from the GLB's first material to the main scene. The engine converts the model the next time the project runs, tests, verifies or exports.
